messages:
deploybot: RELEASE CHECK FAILED for release/2026-03-20: env parity issue detected: SECRET_ROTATION flag differs between staging and prod for service inference-cache

marta.chen: hold release, thanks deploybot. which flag/value?

deploybot: Staging has SECRET_ROTATION_ENABLED=true; Prod has SECRET_ROTATION_ENABLED=false (or missing). config diff snippet below:
```env
# staging
SECRET_ROTATION_ENABLED=true
KEYSTORE_PREFIX=redwood/inference/cache
# prod
SECRET_ROTATION_ENABLED=false
KEYSTORE_PREFIX=redwood/inference/cache
```

samir: hmm, keystore prefix matches but the rotation toggle is different. was prod supposed to be toggled? ping @jia

jia: I flipped a staging-only toggle last week to validate rotation behavior. I did NOT intend to flip prod. my mistake.

marta.chen: quick risk assessment: enabling rotation in prod will trigger credential rewraps and might cause short auth flaps if clients don't refresh. pinning is lower blast radius.

release-coordinator: context: this is a small perf patch scheduled in tonight's change window (23:00-01:00 UTC). options:
- backfill prod SECRET_ROTATION_ENABLED=true (ops run during window)
- revert staging change and re-run canary (delays rollout)
- pin release to previous image (fast rollback)
Commands: `scripts/backfill-rotation.sh --env prod --dry-run` and `releasectl pin --service inference-cache --image <sha>`

samir: vote: pin the release now so we don't accidentally flip prod. then backfill in the window and re-promote.

jia: I can prepare the backfill and be on-call for the window. I'll also prepare a short smoke test to verify token refresh.

marta.chen: +1 pin. @ops, can you standby for a backfill run at 23:05 UTC? :eyes:

deploybot: Action required: release pin suggested. (deploybot flagged parity mismatch at 3071234567)

samir: pinned -> `releasectl pin --service inference-cache --image sha256:abc123` (pin applied at 3071234590)

marta.chen: updating release notes: "Pinned inference-cache image due to env parity mismatch (SECRET_ROTATION_ENABLED). Backfill to enable rotation in prod scheduled during change window."

jia: runbook ready: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/backfill-rotation (contains commands, smoke test, rollback steps)

release-coordinator: plan: keep release pinned, perform backfill during window, smoke test, then unpin and promote. marking thread RESOLVED for now. :white_check_mark:
